related_questions.question: Do COVID tests show results immediately?
related_questions.snippet: Antigen tests* are rapid tests that usually produce results in 15-30 minutes. Positive results are accurate and reliable. However, in general, antigen tests are less likely to detect the virus than NAAT tests, especially when symptoms are not present. Therefore, a single negative antigen test cannot rule out infection.

related_questions.question: What if the line appears immediately on a COVID test?
related_questions.snippet: If you see any line on your COVID test, err on the side of caution and take precautions to avoid spreading the virus to others. related_questions.question: When is the most accurate time to take a COVID test?
related_questions.snippet: If you have symptoms, test immediately, and then test again per the instructions if your first result is negative. If you were exposed to someone who has COVID-19 and you do not have symptoms, wait at least 5 full days after your exposure before testing. If you test too early, you may have an inaccurate result.
